title: Tenant definition
description: One file per tenant at tenants/<name>.yaml. Read by the tenants ApplicationSet (Git files generator) and passed to tenants/chart as a Helm values file. Holds no secrets. Cluster-level settings are not allowed here; the ApplicationSet supplies them.

name.description: Tenant name. Must equal the file name without .yaml. Namespaces are tenant-<name>-<env>, the AppProject is tenant-<name>. At most 20 characters so that hub-mode Application names stay within 63 characters.

description.description: Free text shown on the tenant's AppProject.

groups.description: Identity provider group names. Used as Kubernetes RBAC subjects (kind Group) and as Argo CD project role groups.

admins.description: Bound to ClusterRole edit in dev and view in stage and prod. Argo CD: get and sync.

viewers.description: Bound to ClusterRole view in every environment. Argo CD: get.

environments.description: Environments the tenant gets a namespace in.

sourceRepos.description: Repositories the tenant AppProject may deploy from. Exact URLs only; wildcards are rejected.

quota.description: ResourceQuota hard limits applied to every tenant namespace. Keys are ResourceQuota resource names.

limitRange.description: Container defaults applied when a container sets no requests or limits.

allowEgressCidrs.description: IPv4 ranges outside the cluster the tenant's pods may reach. Default none. Never list the pod or service CIDR: with Canal or Calico an ipBlock also matches pod IPs.

cpu.description: CPU quantity in cores or millicores, for example "2", "0.5" or "500m". Quote it in YAML.

bytes.description: Byte quantity, for example "512Mi", "8Gi" or "1G". Quote it in YAML.

count.description: Object count. Integer or a string of digits.
